cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; A habitat food lab with a small tea station and a bright reading panel above a drawer of spare filters — She draws the intact mesh filter out of a broken tea infuser to reuse it in a clean metal frame; A transparent observation bay beside an orbital hydrotherapy pool — She checks whether one fin has a worn hinge after swimming; a night observatory under an open dome — standing; a convention photo zone under ring lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — pours the batter from a mixing bowl of batter and a whisk into a baking tin; her bedroom — lying on her left side; the grand staircase of an old castle — standing; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds a small hand lantern low at her side
